text:
Mike: RFC follow-up: we need a lightweight compatibility shim for REST v2->v3 field renames. customers hitting 400s in bulk-export.
Tanya: are these body-only renames or query params too?
Samir: both. gateway currently rejects unknown body keys. plan: add a pre-validation rewrite middleware.
Lisa: careful: some v2 fields triggered legacy enrichment (owner_email -> lookup); naive rename could alter semantics.
Mike: propose two modes: pure-rename (deterministic path mapping) and resolver-proxy (forward ambiguous cases to legacy runtime).
Samir: impl sketch: request -> tenant rule lookup -> apply compiled mappings -> add X-RW-Compat-Origin header with rule_ids -> proceed.
Lisa: telemetry: include rule_id, tenant_id, fallback_used boolean, conflict_count. ops-bot should alert if mapping error rate >0.8% over 10m.
Samir: storage: rules live in git-backed config service, compile to trie, push to edge cache for fast eval. manual tenant overrides allowed.
Tanya: security: mappings must pass schema whitelist to avoid privilege escalation. RBAC for editing.
Mike: admin console should show active mappings and include a sample transform tester for support.
Lisa: QA: unit tests for rewrite, integration tests hitting legacy proxy, golden response diff for sample exports.
Samir: perf note: cold miss ~30ms, warm hit <5ms. I'll draft DSL and security checklist by Thu EOD.
Tanya: thanks. pinging @eng-sre and @security for early review once draft is up.
